# Elevate Blog Request Form

Use this form when requesting blog content from an AI writer so output quality stays consistent across topics and contributors.

## Full Form (recommended)

```text
# Elevate Blog Request Form (v1)

## 1) Request Type
- [ ] New article
- [ ] Rewrite existing draft
- [ ] Expand to member/premium depth
- [ ] Convert article into ebook-ready chapter draft

## 2) Target Access Tier
- access_tier: [public | member | premium]

## 3) Topic & Goal
- Working title:
- One-line topic summary:
- Why this topic now:
- Reader outcome (what should change after reading):

## 4) Audience
- Primary audience:
- Secondary audience:
- Reader level mix: [beginner | intermediate | advanced | mixed]
- Must-understand terms to define:

## 5) Core Angle (Anti-duplication)
- Similar existing posts/themes (if known):
- What must be different this time:
  - New angle:
  - New examples:
  - New framework depth:
  - New outcome/CTA:

## 6) References (Optional but recommended)
### 6.1 URL references
- URL 1:
- URL 2:
- URL 3:

### 6.2 Image/media references
- Image URL or file 1:
- Image URL or file 2:
- Video URL (if any):

### 6.3 Notes for references
- What to borrow (insight/data/structure):
- What NOT to copy:
- Citation required? [yes/no/unknown]

## 7) Content Constraints
- Desired length:
- Tone keywords (e.g. practical, calm, credible):
- Must include:
- Must avoid:
- Legal/compliance sensitivities:
- Region/language sensitivities (if any):

## 8) Hands-on Section (Optional)
- Include hands-on tutorial? [yes/no]
- If yes:
  - Tool/model context:
  - Expected output:
  - Prompt examples needed? [yes/no]
  - Safety constraints:

## 9) CTA Strategy
- Primary CTA:
- Secondary CTA (optional):
- CTA URL:
- Conversion intent: [signup | waitlist | paid upgrade | retention]

## 10) SEO / Metadata
- SEO target keyword(s):
- Meta description preference:
- Slug preference (kebab-case):
- Internal links to include:

## 11) Asset & Copyright Policy
- Can use external images? [yes/no]
- Allowed sources (e.g. Unsplash, own assets):
- Attribution format required:
- Disallowed elements (celebrity faces, logos, etc.):

## 12) Output Format Request
- [ ] Full publish-ready MDX
- [ ] Brief + outline + final draft
- [ ] EN only
- [ ] EN + KO (KO should be natural, not literal translation)
- [ ] Add "source & rights notes" section
- [ ] Add "duplication check note" section

## 13) Final QA Priority
Prioritize these checks:
- [ ] factual accuracy
- [ ] legal/copyright safety
- [ ] clarity for all age groups
- [ ] ebook-level structure
- [ ] non-duplication
- [ ] grammar/spelling/spacing

## 14) Extra Instructions
(Anything else the agent must follow)
```

## Quick Form (fast iteration)

```text
[Quick Request]
Topic:
Tier (public/member/premium):
Audience:
Goal:
References (URLs/images):
Must include:
Must avoid:
CTA + URL:
Length:
Output (MDX or brief+draft):
```

## Suggested Workflow

1. Fill either the full or quick form.
2. Attach references and clearly mark which are inspiration versus required evidence.
3. Ask the AI to run a non-duplication check against previously published posts.
4. Request final output in MDX-ready format with `access_tier` aligned to your intent.
